summary.clinical_interpretation:
Across 8 studies, summary sensitivity was 68.90185947% (95% confidence interval 61.74212131% to 75.25862212%) and summary specificity was 90.12971908% (95% confidence interval 79.46477688% to 95.56496609%).
These are average operating characteristics across the included study thresholds. The Reitsma bivariate and HSROC formulations are equivalent parameterizations of this model; that equivalence does not assume a common threshold. Use the prediction intervals to assess how performance may vary in a new setting.

sroc_auc.note: The Reitsma bivariate and HSROC models are equivalent parameterizations of the same threshold-aware diagnostic model; this does not imply a common threshold.
sroc_auc.auc_confidence_interval: Not provided by mada::AUC(); no invented AUC CI.

between_study_heterogeneity.Interpretation: SDs and covariance are on the model logit scale; correlation is unitless.

diagnostic_i_squared.interpretation: I-squared is shown as percent unexplained heterogeneity; Zhou-Dendukuri and Holling are distinct estimators.

historical_exe_smoke.scope: As-is published v0.3.1 RCMetaStudio.exe --automation-smoke against its packaged amino.rcms sample. This automation opens and exercises the app, performs its fixed binary.random OR workflow, locale save/reopen checks, and packaged-sample checks. It is not a user-operated GUI journey, does not cover the five route matrix, and is not human or cross-platform parity evidence.
